issue.title: Rename home-screen app label to Fluent Mobile
issue.body:
## Summary

Change the **user-facing app name** (the label under the Android home-screen / launcher icon) from **Fluent Demo** to **Fluent Mobile**.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Display name only — what users see under the app icon (Expo `name` / Android `android:label` via Expo config)

**Out of scope**
- Android package / application id (`com.eten.fluent`)
- Expo slug, scheme, EAS project id
- Bundle identifiers or any deep store listing metadata beyond the launcher label
- In-app copy, marketing sites, or docs renames (unless the launcher name is documented and should match)

## Current state

[`app.config.ts`](app.config.ts) currently sets `name: 'Fluent'`. On device, builds may still show **Fluent Demo** (older config or a prior build). Target display name: **Fluent Mobile**.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Launcher / home-screen label under the app icon reads **Fluent Mobile**
- [ ] Android `package` / application id is unchanged (`com.eten.fluent`)
- [ ] Expo slug, scheme, and EAS project settings are unchanged
- [ ] Verified on an Android device or emulator after a native rebuild (display name is baked into the binary)

## Verification

1. Update Expo `name` (and any related display-name config only if required)
2. Rebuild Android (dev client or preview/nightly APK — not JS-only OTA)
3. Install and confirm the icon label is **Fluent Mobile**

## Notes

Display name changes require a **native rebuild**; OTA/JS-only updates will not change the launcher label.

comments.body: Closing as unnecessary: the launcher/app name in app.config.ts is already `Fluent` (not "Fluent Demo"), and there is no "Fluent Demo" string anywhere in this repository. No rename work is required for this ticket.
